sources.entry: eul - macOS status monitoring app written in SwiftUI.

summary.one_liner: eul is a macOS status monitoring app written in SwiftUI, with Bluetooth battery level display and Big Sur widgets.
summary.what_it_does: eul is a menubar-style macOS status monitor built mostly in SwiftUI. The README highlights Dark Mode support, Big Sur widgets, and display of Bluetooth device battery levels. It can be installed by downloading the release .app file, via Homebrew Cask, or from the App Store. The README notes that the App Store version is out of date and that some features were disabled after removal of all SMC calls. It also lists localization in about 20 languages. The README does not describe specific metrics beyond Bluetooth battery levels.
use_cases: monitor mac system status from the menu bar
check bluetooth device battery levels on mac
view mac status in big sur widgets
install a mac status app with homebrew
how_to_run: Download the latest release and drag the .app file into the Application folder
notable: Written in SwiftUI as much as possible
caveats: App Store version is out of date
Some features disabled after removal of all SMC calls
keywords: view mac status at a glance
